sources.name: OS NGD API – Features Technical Specification
sources.role: landing, conformance, collections, schema, queryables and feature-query endpoint contract
verified_facts: The OS NGD API – Features specification exposes landing, conformance, collections, collection, schema, queryables, features and individual-feature resources.
semantic_limits: API discovery or conformance does not prove that a particular feature payload was retrieved completely.

sources.name: OS NGD API – Features Collection Items Endpoint
sources.role: bbox, CRS, datetime, limit, offset and CQL subset contract
verified_facts: The collection-items endpoint supports bounding-box, response-CRS, datetime, limit, offset and filter parameters.
semantic_limits: A page of up to 100 features is not evidence that the complete collection was examined.

sources.name: OS NGD API – Individual Feature Endpoint
sources.role: feature identifier, response CRS and status-code contract
verified_facts: Retrieving an individual feature requires a collection identifier and feature identifier.
semantic_limits: A found identifier does not prove cadastral authority or legal-boundary status.

sources.name: OS NGD API – Collection Endpoint
sources.role: collection extent, supported CRS, storage CRS and link contract
verified_facts: A collection response describes spatial or temporal extent, supported coordinate reference systems and related links.
semantic_limits: Collection-level CRS metadata does not prove every feature geometry is valid.

sources.name: OS NGD API – Collection Schema Endpoint
sources.role: collection schema and property-definition contract
verified_facts: The schema endpoint publishes the structure associated with a collection.
semantic_limits: Schema conformance does not establish the truth, completeness or freshness of feature values.

sources.name: OS NGD API – Queryables Endpoint
sources.role: filterable attribute and type contract
verified_facts: The queryables endpoint lists collection attributes available for filtering.
semantic_limits: A queryable property is not necessarily present on every returned feature.

sources.name: OS NGD API – Tiles Technical Specification
sources.role: tile discovery, collections, matrix sets, styles and tile retrieval contract
verified_facts: The OS NGD Tiles specification exposes landing, conformance, collections, tile-matrix-set, tile and style resources.
semantic_limits: A tile is a spatially constrained representation and not proof that the complete source collection was read.

sources.name: OS NGD API – Tiles Collection Endpoint
sources.role: tile collection CRS, extent and related-resource link contract
verified_facts: The tile collection response describes the collection, its spatial extent, supported CRS information and links.
semantic_limits: A tile collection extent is not exact parcel geometry.

sources.name: OS Features API Overview
sources.role: WFS access, feature filtering, update cadence and transaction-size contract
verified_facts: The OS Features API is based on Web Feature Service access to OS feature products.
semantic_limits: A WFS transaction page is not a complete-source examination.

sources.name: OS Features API Paging
sources.role: count, start index and previous/next page-link contract
verified_facts: Feature paging uses count and start-index controls.
semantic_limits: Following one next link does not prove all pages were traversed.

sources.name: OS Features API Filtering
sources.role: OGC XML filter, attribute selection and bbox-precedence contract
verified_facts: The API accepts OGC XML filters using attributes advertised by DescribeFeatureType.
semantic_limits: Filter syntax success does not prove exact polygon containment.

sources.name: OS Features API Empty Values
sources.role: omitted attribute, null and empty-string interpretation contract
verified_facts: The API returns populated attributes and can omit properties without values.
semantic_limits: An omitted numeric property must not be converted to zero.

sources.name: OGC API – Coverages
sources.role: draft coverage resource, schema, domain and range subset API contract
verified_facts: OGC API – Coverages is being developed as modular Web API building blocks for coverage resources.
semantic_limits: The specification is draft work and must not be represented as a final approved OGC Standard.

sources.name: OGC API – Styles
sources.role: draft style discovery, retrieval and management contract
verified_facts: OGC API – Styles defines Web API building blocks for discovering, retrieving and managing styles.
semantic_limits: The specification is draft work and must not be described as a final approved OGC Standard.

sources.name: OGC API – Connected Systems Standards Suite
sources.role: connected-system resource, observation and dynamic-data standards-suite contract
verified_facts: The OGC API – Connected Systems suite provides APIs for connected systems, sensors, platforms, procedures and observations.
semantic_limits: Connected-system metadata does not prove that a sensor or processing pipeline produced the preserved parcel values.

sources.name: OGC API – Connected Systems Part 1: Feature Resources
sources.role: system, procedure, deployment and feature-resource contract
verified_facts: Part 1 standardizes feature resources used to describe connected systems and related entities.
semantic_limits: A feature-resource relationship does not prove actual execution or measurement.

sources.name: OGC API – Connected Systems Part 2: Dynamic Data
sources.role: datastream, observation, command and dynamic-data contract
verified_facts: Part 2 standardizes access to dynamic data associated with connected systems.
semantic_limits: A returned observation is not parcel-height evidence unless procedure, unit, time, source and feature-of-interest bindings match.

sources.name: OGC GeoParquet Standards Working Group Announcement
sources.role: GeoParquet standards-development and cloud-native vector-format governance contract
verified_facts: OGC formed a Standards Working Group to develop GeoParquet as a geospatial extension to Apache Parquet.
semantic_limits: GeoParquet work-in-progress must not be represented as a final approved OGC Standard.

sources.publisher: Internet Engineering Task Force / RFC Editor
sources.name: RFC 8785 — JSON Canonicalization Scheme
sources.role: deterministic JSON serialization and hash-input contract
verified_facts: RFC 8785 defines a canonical JSON representation intended for repeatable hashing and signing.
semantic_limits: Canonical JSON equality proves serialization equivalence under the scheme, not source truth.

sources.publisher: Internet Engineering Task Force / RFC Editor
sources.name: RFC 8259 — The JavaScript Object Notation Data Interchange Format
sources.role: JSON syntax, object, array, number and interoperability contract
verified_facts: RFC 8259 defines JSON as a text format for structured data.
semantic_limits: Valid JSON syntax does not prove schema conformance, source authority or semantic correctness.

sources.publisher: Internet Engineering Task Force / RFC Editor
sources.name: RFC 3339 — Date and Time on the Internet: Timestamps
sources.role: timestamp, UTC offset and Internet date-time profile contract
verified_facts: RFC 3339 defines an Internet profile for date and time representations.
semantic_limits: A syntactically valid timestamp does not prove observation, acquisition or publication semantics.

sources.publisher: Internet Engineering Task Force / RFC Editor
sources.name: RFC 9457 — Problem Details for HTTP APIs
sources.role: machine-readable HTTP API error-detail contract
verified_facts: RFC 9457 defines problem detail objects for carrying machine-readable HTTP API error information.
semantic_limits: An error object describes a failed or exceptional API interaction and is not measurement evidence.

sources.name: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 Core
sources.role: JSON Schema dialect, vocabulary, reference and evaluation core contract
verified_facts: The Draft 2020-12 core specification defines JSON Schema dialects, vocabularies and reference resolution.
semantic_limits: Schema resolution success does not prove that referenced external data was downloaded or trusted.

sources.name: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 Validation
sources.role: JSON assertion keyword and instance-validation contract
verified_facts: The validation specification defines assertion keywords for constraining JSON instances.
semantic_limits: A valid JSON instance conforms only to the asserted schema constraints; it does not prove real-world truth.
